project.style: Live-action, photoreal, cinematic, cool slate-blue light

generations.name: Cave drips
generations.overall_ambience: The hollow, echoing hush of a sea cave with the faint wash of the sea outside.

shots.opening_state: The basalt sea cave exactly as in the first frame, a drop of water hanging at the tip of each short stalactite above the still pool.
shots.action: Drops fall one after another from the stalactites into the pool, each landing with a clear echoing plink and a small spreading ripple, falling faster until they settle into a steady rhythm, ripples overlapping on the dark pool.

camera.custom_movement: A very slow, smooth dolly forward at eye level toward the cave opening, about one meter of travel over the whole shot.

shots.sound_effects: Each falling drop lands with a crisp plink that echoes off the stone, the drips build into an even rhythm, and in the last two seconds a long low roll of distant thunder carries in from outside the cave.
